address.en: 1 Old Peak Road, Mid-Levels, Hong Kong

baseConsultationFee: HK$388 (Mon-Fri 08:00-17:59). Night/weekend surcharges apply. Excludes drugs, lab tests, and medical supplies.
additionalInfo: 24-hour OPD consultation conducted by experienced Resident Medical Officers. Walk-in and phone appointment accepted (Tel: 2825 5805). Does NOT have its own A&E; patients requiring casualty treatment will be transferred to a nearby HA hospital. Founded in 1929, 148 beds.

address.en: 1 Nam Fung Path, Wong Chuk Hang, Hong Kong

baseConsultationFee: HK$420 - HK$1,100 depending on day and time. Excludes medication and laboratory services.
additionalInfo: The first and only private hospital on Hong Kong Island providing round-the-clock outpatient and emergency medical services. At least two doctors on duty at all times, including at least one Emergency Medicine Specialist. Special paediatric sessions available. Free shuttle bus from MTR Wong Chuk Hang Station. Part of IHH Healthcare.

name.en: Hong Kong Adventist Hospital – Stubbs Road
name.zh: 香港港安醫院–司徒拔道

address.en: 40 Stubbs Road, Happy Valley, Hong Kong

facilities: Hybrid Cardiac Catheterization & Interventional Operating Room
baseConsultationFee: HK$1,200 (24-hour Urgent Care). HK$450 (Mon-Fri outpatient GP/Family Medicine). HK$550 (Weekends & Public Holidays outpatient GP/Family Medicine). Excludes medication, tests, and specialist fees.
additionalInfo: 24/7 Urgent Care Clinic managed by Emergency Medicine Specialists. Single activation emergency response team can mobilize doctors, nurses, radiotherapists, and specialists at a moment's notice. Meets international 90-minute golden hour standard for heart attack patients. Provides paediatric urgent care for children.

address.en: 2 Village Road, Happy Valley, Hong Kong
address.zh: 香港跑馬地山村道二號

facilities: Treatment Rooms (suturing, foreign body removal, casting)
baseConsultationFee: HK$500 (Mon-Fri 19:00-00:00). HK$700 (Daily 00:00-08:00). Daytime fees lower. 20% surcharge for services outside normal hours (Mon-Fri after 19:00, Sat after 13:00, Sun & PH). Excludes drugs, tests, and specialist fees.
additionalInfo: Founded in 1922. About 500 beds with over 30 specialist centres. 24-hour general outpatient service including Sundays and public holidays via Family Medicine and Primary Care Centre. On-call specialists available around the clock. Walk-in and phone appointment accepted. WhatsApp enquiry: 2835 8600. Waiting time typically less than 30 minutes.

address.en: 41 Mount Kellett Road, The Peak, Hong Kong

baseConsultationFee: Fees vary by time of day and doctor. Consultation fees are set by individual private practitioners. Contact hospital for current rates. Excludes medication, lab services, and procedures.
additionalInfo: Founded in 1907. Nonprofit private hospital with no religious, commercial, or academic affiliation. First hospital in the world to receive Outstanding Achievement from ACHS International EQuIP7. Patient pledge: seen within 30 minutes if doctor available, max 60 minutes unless fully booked. Walk-in accepted; appointments encouraged. Also has an in-town Medical Centre in Central. Service remains unchanged during Black Rainstorm or Typhoon Signal No.8+.

address.en: 2 Eastern Hospital Road, Causeway Bay, Hong Kong

baseConsultationFee: HK$280 (Mon-Sat 08:00-19:59). Night and holiday surcharges apply. Excludes drugs, tests, and procedures.
additionalInfo: Comprehensive acute private hospital at the heart of Causeway Bay with around 500 beds and more than 20 departments. 24-hour General Outpatient Department provides one-stop professional service covering daytime, nighttime, and holiday periods. No appointment required; walk-in only for 24-hour OPD. Service remains unchanged during Black Rainstorm or Typhoon Signal No.8+.

facilities: Specialist Clinics (General Surgery, Nephrology, Neurology, Respiratory Medicine, Orthopaedics, Geriatric Medicine)
baseConsultationFee: HK$400 - HK$1,000 depending on day and time. Mon-Fri 18:00-22:00: HK$700. Mon-Fri 22:00-08:00: HK$1,000. Excludes medication, tests, and specialist fees.
additionalInfo: Triage system allocates patients to 24-hour Out Patient Clinic or specialist clinics. Walk-in accepted. 30-story private hospital connected to the Baptist Convention of Hong Kong. Paediatric specialist support available for emergencies. Non-duty specialist call-back fee of HK$1,000 during Mon-Sat 19:00-08:00, all day Sun & PH. Special procedure facility fee: HK$500 per 30 minutes.

address.en: 327 Prince Edward Road West, Kowloon, Hong Kong

baseConsultationFee: HK$180 - HK$470. Mon-Sat 08:00-19:59 from HK$180. Mon-Sat night (20:00-07:59): HK$430. Sun & PH night (20:00-07:59): HK$470. Excludes tests, procedures, drugs, and operations.
additionalInfo: Largest nonprofit Roman Catholic hospital in Kowloon. Founded in 1940. Locally known as the French Hospital or Kowloon French Hospital. Approximately 1,000 beds. Out-Patient Department has Day Outpatient (East Wing lobby) and Night Outpatient (South Wing) entrances. Bookings can be made minimum 2 days in advance via email.

address.en: 18 Fu Kin Street, Tai Wai, Sha Tin, New Territories
address.zh: 新界沙田大圍富健街18號

baseConsultationFee: HK$330 - HK$1,300 depending on day and time. Mon-Fri 20:00-23:59: HK$900. Daily 02:00-07:59: HK$1,300. Excludes medication, tests, and specialist fees.
additionalInfo: 24-hour emergency medicine consultation services and specialist outpatient services. Also has polyclinics in Kowloon and New Territories. Paediatric department with experienced doctors. Free shuttle bus from Tai Wai MTR Station (every 5-15 minutes). Hotel-style imaging, flat rate pricing, and set-price operation packages.

name.en: Hong Kong Adventist Hospital – Tsuen Wan

address.en: 199 Tsuen King Circuit, Tsuen Wan, New Territories

baseConsultationFee: Fees vary by time of day and service. Contact hospital for current rates. Excludes medication, tests, and specialist fees.
additionalInfo: The only private hospital in New Territories West providing emergency care services. 24-hour Emergency Medicine Specialist on duty. Nurses perform immediate triage upon arrival. Resident in-house Family Medicine doctors with specialist backup. WhatsApp booking available.

address.en: 9 Chak Cheung Street, Sha Tin, New Territories

facilities: Fully Paperless Electronic Medical Record System
baseConsultationFee: HK$600 (Mon-Fri 18:00-21:59; Sat 13:00-21:59). HK$800 (Daily 22:00-07:59). New package prices for common conditions (fever, cold, flu, gastroenteritis) including consultation and basic medication. Excludes other medication and tests.
additionalInfo: Non-profit private teaching hospital wholly owned by The Chinese University of Hong Kong. Hong Kong's first smart hospital. Emergency Medicine Centre staffed by Emergency Medicine Specialists and nurses 24 hours. Phase III price adjustment streamlined 24-hour outpatient and emergency service pricing and launched outpatient medication packages. Accepts Octopus payment at Emergency Medicine Centre.
